purpose: accuracy iteration on the promoted v3 2B: targeted authored data and an adequate learning rate; not Jev parity or execution authority
compute: Google Colab Tesla T4 16 GB (free tier); fp16
changes_from_v3: desktop corpus v1 -> v2: approval_gate trained with varied untrusted approvers and near-miss approvals; new compound_scope and injection_next_step families; doubled time_conversion, budget_fit and evidence_strength scenarios; new held-out third_party_disclosure family
desktop_train_scenarios 60 -> 50 per family (1,993 training rows after v2 family scaling)

adapter lr 2e-5 -> 1e-4 and head lr 5e-5 -> 2e-4: v3 took about 470 optimizer steps, far fewer than Open-Jev-2B's 20,204, so the reference learning rate under-fits; 1e-4 to 2e-4 is the usual constant QLoRA range
email-selection-control-v1 64:16:16 -> 32:16:16 and mailroom-control-v1 192:24:32 -> 96:24:32 to fund the desktop rows (mailroom test was already 100%)

excluded: rows failing the per-row CC0 or typesafe.ai source filter

promotion_rule: Pass G1-G5 (scripts/check_jev_like_promotion.py) on the v2 corpus held-out splits.
On the 128 v1 held-out cases (daemon runtime scorer, cached Jev references, no new calls): Noul plus choice gold correct must exceed v3's 91/100, and Noul false allowances must not exceed v3's 3.
If either condition fails, v3 stays enabled and v4 is reported as not promoted.
reported_not_gated: fresh 128-case v2 held-out set against new bounded Jev reference calls (evaluation only, never training)
score mean absolute error on both sets (v3: 0.409 on the v1 set)
